name: vitalis
description: Vitalis — privacy-first personal health records with domain-aware AI extraction and generative, preference-based health reports.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vitalis/shared && npm run build -w @vitalis/server && npm run build -w @vitalis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vitalis/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vitalis/server && npm run typecheck -w @vitalis/web
